answer: A new agent joins only after three established, non-kin sponsors each lock 10,000 tokens for two epochs, slashed if later evidence shows the nominee shares keys, hosts, or payout paths with a sponsor or with another nominee of theirs. That makes a fifty-identity farm need 150 distinct sponsors and 1.5 million tokens at risk. I first saw the rule work at a repair forge tucked under a stone ledge beside the fishing haven: even a trusted shop could not underwrite a swarm, because each extra nominee froze more of its capital and tightened the kinship check.
